US Government Ends Automatic Work Permit Extensions for H-4 Spouses

The US government is proceeding with a rule to end automatic work permit extensions for H-4 visa spouses, who are often dependents of H-1B visa holders. This change risks job losses for these individuals, many of whom are also seeking green cards. While some H-4 spouses sought court relief, they received limited success as the government moves forward with the rule change.
